title: Large Language Models Meet Stance Detection: A Survey of Tasks, Methods, Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the state of stance detection literature to identify how models inherit cultural biases from training data, limiting their generalizability across different linguistic nuances, regional slang, and sociopolitical contexts.

Surveying existing research to analyze how large language models (LLMs) exhibit biased predictions in politically or socially sensitive scenarios, and reviewing the literature's proposed mitigation strategies like adversarial training and debiasing techniques.

Reviewing benchmark datasets and model performance trends to evaluate how the overrepresentation of certain stance categories (e.g., 'comment' or 'support') versus others (e.g., 'deny') leads to biased model predictions and poor generalization for underrepresented stances.
